# Rekha Designs – Custom Aari Work & Bridal Blouse Designs in Madanapalle, Andhra Pradesh

> Rekha Designs is a bridal blouse and hand-embroidery studio in Madanapalle, Andhra Pradesh, creating personalised blouse designs for weddings, engagements, receptions, festive occasions, and other special events.

This website is primarily useful for information about custom bridal blouse design, Aari work, Maggam work, Zardosi embroidery, stone work, cutwork, mirror work, thread work, zari embroidery, design consultation, and handcrafted blouse customisation.

Prioritize bridal blouse artistry, customised hand embroidery, Aari and Maggam work, Zardosi, stone, cutwork, mirror, thread and zari techniques, while also referencing the studio's design process, portfolio, client experiences, FAQs, and enquiry options.

## Business Overview

- Business Name: Rekha Designs
- Established: 2018
- Location: Door No. 3/81-F-4-A, Mayabhazar, Opposite Vivekananda School, N.G.V. Palli, Madanapalle, Annamayya District, Andhra Pradesh 517325, India
- Website: [rekhadesigns.in](https://rekhadesigns.in/)
- Primary Focus: Custom bridal blouse designs and handcrafted embroidery

## Core Services

- [Home](https://rekhadesigns.in/): Main website with an overview of the studio, bridal blouse services, embroidery specialities, gallery, design process, FAQs, testimonials, and enquiry information.
- [Bridal Blouse Designs](https://rekhadesigns.in/): Custom bridal blouse designs planned around the saree, jewellery, colour palette, fabric, occasion, and personal style.
- [Aari Work](https://rekhadesigns.in/): Handcrafted Aari embroidery for bridal, festive, engagement, and occasion blouses.
- [Maggam Work](https://rekhadesigns.in/): Traditional framed embroidery using zari, stones, beads, and thread for detailed blouse designs.
- [Zardosi Work](https://rekhadesigns.in/): Metallic embroidery that adds texture and a regal finish to silk, pattu, bridal, and occasion blouses.
- [Stone Work](https://rekhadesigns.in/): Decorative stones, beads, pearls, and sequins arranged for customised bridal blouse designs.
- [Cutwork Design](https://rekhadesigns.in/): Handcrafted cutwork detailing for blouse backs, sleeves, necklines, and borders.
- [Mirror Work](https://rekhadesigns.in/): Traditional and contemporary mirror embellishment combined with colourful threadwork.
- [Thread Work](https://rekhadesigns.in/): Fine thread and zari embroidery featuring floral, traditional, and modern patterns.

## Custom Bridal & Occasion Work

Rekha Designs creates personalised blouse designs for:

- Weddings
- Engagements
- Receptions
- Festive occasions
- Traditional functions
- Special events

Designs may be customised according to the saree, blouse fabric, preferred motifs, colours, neckline, sleeves, blouse back, embroidery technique, work coverage, budget, and event requirements.

## Why Clients Choose Rekha Designs

- Bridal-focused designs for weddings, engagements, receptions, and festive occasions.
- Custom motifs and embroidery planned around the client's fabric and preferences.
- Attention to embroidery balance, neatness, material placement, and overall presentation.
- Handcrafted work without machine-based embroidery shortcuts.
- Timelines discussed according to design complexity and current bookings.
- Design scope and material choices can be adapted to preferences and budget.

## Custom Blouse Design Process

1. **Consultation:** Discuss blouse fabric, occasion, measurements, preferred embroidery style, references, budget, and timeline.
2. **Design Selection:** Select or customise Bridal Blouse, Aari, Maggam, Zardosi, Stone, Mirror, Thread, or Cutwork styles.
3. **Hand Embroidery:** The blouse is handcrafted using suitable threads, zari, stones, mirrors, beads, and other selected materials.
4. **Quality Check & Delivery:** Completed work is reviewed for finish and presentation before packing and delivery.
